components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button: wine background, white bold centered text, rounded corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #8B1A3A; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 24px; transition: opacity 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B1A3A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent background, wine border and text.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #8B1A3A; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; border: 1.5px solid #8B1A3A; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 24px; transition: background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(139, 26, 58, 0.06); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B1A3A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bordered Input
components.description: Contained text field: white background, full border, rounded corners.
components.css: .ds-input-bordered-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E8D8CF; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; padding-right: 10px; } .ds-input-bordered { height: 50px; color: #8B1A3A; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; flex: 1; padding-left: 14px; border: none; background: transparent; } .ds-input-bordered::placeholder { color: #c9b1a7; } .ds-input-bordered:focus { outline: none; } .ds-input-bordered-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #8B1A3A; }

components.name: Underline Input
components.description: Lightweight text field: transparent background, bottom border only.
components.css: .ds-input-underline-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid #E8D8CF; transition: border-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-input-underline { height: 50px; color: #8B1A3A; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; flex: 1; padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 10px; border: none; background: transparent; } .ds-input-underline::placeholder { color: #c9b1a7; } .ds-input-underline:focus { outline: none; } .ds-input-underline-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #8B1A3A; }

narrative.overview: Ghamrah reads like a well-kept planning book: wine-red ink on cream pages, unhurried and considered, with one elegant script flourish reserved for the moments that matter most. The system is warm and personal rather than transactional — every screen is designed to lower the anxiety of a high-stakes, emotional task, not add to it. Confidence comes from restraint: generous whitespace, a single confident accent color used deliberately, and soft, ambient depth rather than decoration. This system explicitly rejects the sterile, corporate booking-tool look and the wedding-industry clichés of pastel gradients, script-everywhere typography, and cluttered Pinterest-board density — warmth lives in the palette and in a few deliberate typographic gestures, not in ornament.
keyCharacteristics: One confident wine-red primary against a warm cream base — restrained, not saturated everywhere
A ceremonial display face (Aboreto) for structure, a script accent (SendFlowers) used sparingly for warmth
Soft, rounded, ambient-shadow surfaces — nothing sharp, nothing harsh
RTL-first: every component mirrors correctly for Arabic before English is checked

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Wine is the only color allowed to carry emphasis or call-to-action weight. Semantic colors signal state and state alone.

rules.name: The Sparing Script Rule
rules.body: SendFlowers appears at most once per screen, reserved for a single emotional highlight.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are warm-tinted and diffused in every direction — never a hard drop shadow, never used to imply directional light or interactivity.

dos: Do keep Wine (#8B1A3A) as the only color that carries call-to-action or emphasis weight; everything else is neutral or semantic.
Do use the warm cream base (#FDF8F5) for every screen background — never pure white as the page background.
Do keep shadows soft, warm-tinted, and ambient (rgba(154, 112, 96, 0.3)) — a consistent lift, not a state-driven effect.
Do verify RTL mirroring (text alignment, icon direction, layout flow) on every new component before shipping it.
Do reserve SendFlowers script type for one sparing emotional highlight per screen, at most.
donts: Don't default to a cold, corporate booking-tool layout — no sterile SaaS card grids, no generic e-commerce checkout patterns.
Don't reach for wedding-industry clichés: script fonts throughout, pastel gradients, stock bridal imagery, or cluttered Pinterest-board density.
Don't use a hard black drop shadow or increase shadow intensity to signal a pressed/focused state.
Don't use semantic colors (green/red/blue/orange) for anything but state and feedback.
Don't mix the underline and bordered input designs on the same screen or form.
